title: boehmeria nivea var. nipononivea
intro: Boehmeria nivea var. nipononivea, commonly known as Japanese mulberry or Chinese mulberry, is a plant species of the nettle family (Urticaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. Boehmeria nivea var. nipononivea is rich in bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
